overview_description.description: Birdie is building the Customer Intelligence Layer — unifying feedback, behavior, and identity into a real-time AI foundation for product-led companies. Our platform surfaces patterns, pinpoints friction, and quantifies impact, giving teams a single source of truth to drive action across Product, Growth, and CX. With integrated VoC OS and Agent QA modules, Birdie transforms scattered customer signals into operational intelligence, powering measurable improvements in experience, retention, and efficiency.
